title: HandlerManifest
description: Rust-owned immutable artifact-local handler metadata generated by a frontend's package-handler build tool. It carries only artifact-local executable source and content-addressed identity; it is never an author-edited protocol or runtime selector. Every descriptor has the same shape whichever frontend emitted it, and `language` selects the private worker that evaluates the source. A build artifact's handler manifest is decoded and validated against this schema before being trusted as artifact metadata.

HandlerDescriptor.description: One portable tool descriptor. A capability-addressable tool handler must carry an object argument schema. `language` is closed to the frontends that ship both a bundler and a worker, and it names the worker the composition root selects to evaluate `source`.

HandlerSource.description: Artifact-local executable source. `artifact_path` is a relative path confined to the artifact and never a build-host path.
